text: Pressure at the terminal point TP-G1: normal 55-65 barg, minimum 45 barg for full load, exceptional 40 barg for up to 72 h/year; temperature 5-25 degC (ALP-OWN-FUL-001 section 6). No gas compressor is provided: between 40 and 45 barg the gas turbine operates on gas at the pressure-limited load (about 60 % GT load at 40 barg); below 40 barg the control system transfers automatically to LDO (ER-03.10).
title: Gas supply conditions at terminal point
